name: dell-maven-module-framework-testing
description: DELL — Maven-style module layout with Newman Postman tests and historical analytics dashboard

scripts.analytics:import:selenium-tdd: cd selenium-tdd-testing && node ../scripts/copy-junit.mjs selenium-java-tdd com.dell.testing.selenium.tdd.LoginLogoutTddTest && cd .. && analytics-dashboard import selenium-tdd-testing/reports/junit/selenium-java-tdd.xml --format junit-xml --tool selenium-java-tdd --application-type UI --methodology TDD --config dashboard.config.ts
scripts.test:ui:selenium-tdd:dashboard: npm run test:ui:selenium-tdd && npm run analytics:import:selenium-tdd && npm run analytics:generate
